correctness.rationale: A full factor-type bijection for binary four-one words gives theta=floor(max gap/2)+|P2|+|P4|. Deterministic C++ visits each of 275234400 increasing-four-position words at lengths 4..128 once and calculates exact minima and counts. An independent direct-substring C++ checker agrees for every n=4..50; Python direct substring checker agrees n=4..18. A separate family checker proves all proposed words meet the recorded optimum, and optimizer counts match the exhaustive counts. No infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The first unsolved fixed-minority-weight Parikh class of an explicit April 2026 problem is resolved at 110 successive new lengths. Beyond confirming a predicted minimum, the work classifies every extremizer and its sharp 2/2/8/4 residue-class multiplicity. The finite cutoff n=128 is a substantial, reproducible benchmark for conjectures and future uniform proofs, not an arbitrary slice or routine restatement.
